description: Main source file for a Flutter-based mobile audiobook library app. It includes class definitions (Audiobook, PlaybackData), state management (AppState), and UI components for store, library, and player screens with functionalities like purchasing, playing, pausing, seeking, and persisting data via SQLite.

classes.name: Audiobook
classes.description: Model representing an audiobook with ID, title, author, description, cover URL, audio URL, and price.

classes.name: PlaybackData
classes.description: Model storing playback progress of an audiobook identified by bookId.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: State management class handling application data, purchases, playback, database interactions, and simulating audio playback.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that loads environment variables and runs the Flutter app with a ChangeNotifierProvider.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes SharedPreferences, the database, loads library and playback data, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Simulates a purchase process and adds the book to the library.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sets the current book for playback, loads last position, and starts simulated playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback simulation if a book is selected.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and resets current position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the current audiobook.

methods.name: skipForward
methods.description: Skips forward by 15 seconds in playback.

methods.name: skipBackward
methods.description: Skips backward by 15 seconds in playback.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns playback progress as a percentage (0.0 to 1.0).

methods.name: _simulatePlayback
methods.description: Simulates audio playback by periodically updating playback position.
